conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const users = ($env.N8N_COMMAND_USERS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const login = ($json.body.sender && $json.body.sender.login) || ''; return users.includes(login); })() }}

parameters.command:
=set -eo pipefail
export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk
export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v javac)")")")"
export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
cd ~/workspace
SHA="{{ $json.head.sha }}"
SHORT_SHA="${SHA:0:7}"
PR_NUM="{{ $('Parse command').item.json.prNumber }}"
REPO="{{ $('Parse command').item.json.repoFull }}"
TARGET="{{ $('Parse command').item.json.target }}"
RELEASE_TAG="pr-${PR_NUM}-build"
git fetch origin
git checkout "$SHA"
if [ "$TARGET" = "ios" ]; then
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes mac-host ios "$SHA" >&2
  echo "ios build finished for $SHA"
else
  mkdir -p kotlin-mls/src/main
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes mac-host jnilibs "$SHA" | tar -x -C kotlin-mls/src/main
  rm -f clients/android/StellarChat/app/google-services.json
  echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_HOME" > clients/android/StellarChat/local.properties
  (cd clients/android/StellarChat && ./gradlew assembleFdroidDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace) >&2
  APK=$(ls -1 clients/android/StellarChat/app/build/outputs/apk/fdroid/debug/*.apk 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
  if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
    echo "android build for $SHA produced no APK" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  ASSET_NAME="stellarchat-pr${PR_NUM}-${SHORT_SHA}.apk"
  cp "$APK" "/tmp/$ASSET_NAME"
  # Extract GitHub token from the embedded remote URL (first-run.sh seeds it
  # there), so gh works even when GITHUB_TOKEN isn't in this SSH session.
  export GH_TOKEN="$(git config --get remote.origin.url | sed -n 's|.*x-access-token:\([^@]*\)@.*|\1|p')"
  if [ -z "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: could not extract GH_TOKEN from workspace remote URL" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$REPO" --prerelease \
      --title "PR #${PR_NUM} builds" \
      --notes "Automated debug builds for PR #${PR_NUM}. Latest build at the top of the asset list." >&2
  fi
  gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "/tmp/$ASSET_NAME" --repo "$REPO" --clobber >&2
  rm -f "/tmp/$ASSET_NAME"
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${RELEASE_TAG}/${ASSET_NAME}"
  echo "android build finished for $SHA"
  echo "artifact: $APK ($(du -h "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'))"
  echo "download: $DOWNLOAD_URL"
fi
